description: Comprehensive UI/UX design rules and recommendations

rules.title: Color Contrast Ratio
rules.rule: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
rules.how: Use contrast checker tool, aim for 7:1 for AAA compliance

rules.title: Alternative Text for Images
rules.rule: All images must have descriptive alt text
rules.how: Write concise alt text describing the image content and purpose

rules.title: Keyboard Navigation
rules.rule: All functionality must work with keyboard (Tab, Enter, Escape)
rules.how: Test with keyboard only, ensure focus indicators visible

rules.title: ARIA Labels
rules.rule: Form inputs, buttons, landmarks need proper ARIA attributes
rules.how: Use aria-label, aria-describedby, aria-live where appropriate

rules.title: Focus Indicators
rules.rule: Focused elements must have visible 2px+ outline or equivalent
rules.how: Never remove default focus outlines, ensure 3:1 color contrast

rules.title: Color Independence
rules.rule: Color must not be the only means of conveying information
rules.how: Combine color with text, patterns, or icons for meaning

rules.title: Touch Target Size
rules.rule: Minimum 44×44 pixels for all interactive elements
rules.why: Apple HIG, Material Design, accessibility standard
rules.how: Increase padding, use semantic buttons, test on real devices

rules.title: Touch Target Spacing
rules.rule: At least 8px gap between adjacent touch targets
rules.why: Prevent accidental taps, improve accuracy
rules.how: Use margin or gap in flexbox/grid

rules.title: Loading Feedback
rules.rule: Show spinner, skeleton, or progress for async operations
rules.why: User knows something is happening, prevents duplicate taps
rules.how: Add loading state, disable button during submission

rules.title: Hover States
rules.rule: Hover must be distinct from normal state (not just opacity)
rules.why: Clear feedback that element is interactive
rules.how: Add background color change, scale, or shadow

rules.title: Image Format
rules.rule: Use WebP/AVIF with PNG fallback, optimize file size
rules.how: Use ImageOptim, Squoosh, or CDN image service

rules.title: Lazy Loading
rules.rule: Load images below fold on scroll or demand
rules.how: Use loading='lazy' attribute or Intersection Observer

rules.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
rules.rule: CLS < 0.1, reserve space for dynamic content
rules.how: Use skeletons, aspect-ratio, height: auto with min-height

rules.title: Code Splitting
rules.rule: Load only JavaScript needed per route/feature
rules.how: Use dynamic imports, tree-shaking, minimize dependencies

rules.title: Responsive Breakpoints
rules.rule: Mobile-first: 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px
rules.why: Covers all device sizes from old phones to 4K monitors

rules.title: No Horizontal Scroll
rules.rule: Content must fit viewport width on all breakpoints
rules.why: Horizontal scroll is terrible UX, breaks mobile experience
rules.fix: Use overflow-x: hidden, max-width: 100vw, flexbox layout

rules.title: Viewport Meta Tag
rules.rule: Must include: <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'>
rules.why: Enables responsive design on mobile browsers
rules.impact: Without this, mobile sees desktop version (zoomed out)

rules.title: Base Font Size
rules.rule: 16px for body text (standard across all platforms)
rules.why: Optimal readability, matches OS defaults

rules.title: Line Height
rules.rule: 1.4-1.6 for body text (not 1.2 or 2.0)
rules.why: Optimal readability, screen-friendly spacing

rules.title: Line Length
rules.rule: 60-80 characters per line for comfortable reading
rules.why: Eyes don't have to travel far, reduces cognitive load

rules.title: Semantic Color Tokens
rules.rule: Use named tokens (primary, secondary, error) not hex values
rules.why: Easier theming, maintainability, dark mode support

rules.title: Color Palette
rules.rule: Use 1 primary + 1-2 secondary colors + neutrals
rules.why: Prevents visual chaos, strengthens brand identity

rules.title: Animation Duration
rules.rule: 150-300ms for UI feedback (not 1000ms+)
rules.why: Feels responsive, not sluggish

rules.title: Easing Functions
rules.rule: Use ease-out for entrance, ease-in for exit
rules.why: Feels natural, matches real-world physics

rules.title: Visible Labels
rules.rule: Labels must be visible (not placeholder text)
rules.why: Placeholder disappears on focus, confuses users

rules.title: Error Messages
rules.rule: Show error near the field with clear message
rules.why: User can quickly locate and fix the problem
rules.pattern: Red outline + text below input + aria-invalid='true'

rules.title: Validation Timing
rules.rule: Validate on blur, not on every keystroke
rules.why: Reduces false positives, better UX

rules.title: Back Button Behavior
rules.rule: Back button goes to previous screen (not menu toggle)
rules.why: Users expect predictable browser behavior

rules.title: Bottom Navigation
rules.rule: Max 5 items on mobile (6+ items use drawer/tabs)
rules.why: Thumb-friendly, common mobile pattern

rules.title: Deep Linking
rules.rule: Every screen must have shareable URL
rules.why: Users can bookmark, share, come back to exact location
rules.how: Each route gets unique URL path

rules.title: Chart Legends
rules.rule: Always include legend or clear labeling
rules.why: Users need to understand what colors/patterns mean
rules.placement: Right side for desktop, below for mobile

rules.title: Tooltips
rules.rule: Show exact values on hover/tap
rules.why: Users want precise data, not just visual trend

rules.title: Accessible Chart Colors
rules.rule: Use colorblind-friendly palettes (not red-green alone)
rules.why: 8% of males, 0.5% of females have color blindness

styles.name: Dark
styles.description: Dark backgrounds, light text, night mode

styles.name: Content-First
styles.typography: Large serif or modern sans-serif, generous line height

styles.name: Accessible
styles.description: High contrast, large text, clear structure
